newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes lower at 1,028.50.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes lower at 1,028.50.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed lower after falling under pressure from month-end position-squaring by banks and other financial institutions that were short of dollars, interbank dealers said.
They said the local currency, which hit a seven-month high of 1,022.00 against the dollar last Thursday, extended Friday's losses by dropping an additional 4.7 pesos to close at 1,028.50.
Dealers reported 180 trades for a lower-than-average total of $60 million and said the peso moved in a 1,024 to 1,028.65 range.
